"Hey Daddy (Daddy's Home)" is a song by American singer Usher.
It was written by longtime Usher collaborator Rico Love, Usher, Plies as well as Andrew Harr and Jermaine Jackson from production duo The Runners for his sixth studio album Raymond v.
Raymond (2010), while production was helmed by Love, Harr, and Jackson.
American singer Usher has released nine studio albums, ten compilation albums, eight extended plays, and eighty-one singles (including nineteen as a featured artist).
His music has been released on the LaFace, Arista, Jive, RCA, and gamma record labels.
Usher has sold more than 33 million albums in the United States alone and over 65 million albums worldwide.
Usher Raymond IV (born October 14, 1978) is an American singer, songwriter, dancer, and actor.
An influential figure in contemporary R&B and pop music, he was ranked among the greatest singers of all time by Rolling Stone and the greatest pop stars of the 21st century by Billboard.
